label: The Silver Claim
summary: You inherit a silver claim in the hills above Dust Creek, and three different people say they own it first.
title: The Silver Claim
description: Your uncle’s will leaves you a mining claim, a mule and a map with one corner torn off. The bank wants the claim, a rancher swears it is on his land, and the mine itself has not been opened in a year.

chapterOutlines.title: The Reading of the Will
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive in Dust Creek, meet the people who want your claim, and find the torn map.

chapterOutlines.title: Up in the Hills
chapterOutlines.outline: Open the mine and learn why your uncle stopped working it.

chapterOutlines.title: Claim Day
chapterOutlines.outline: The land office settles the claim, if everyone lives that long.

scene.location: The back room of the Dust Creek land office
scene.summary: Noon, heat like an oven. The clerk reads the will aloud while three people in the doorway watch you and not the paper.

openThreads: What is on the torn corner of the map?
Why did your uncle stop mining?

npcs.name: Ada Pruitt
npcs.description: Knows every claim filed in the territory and which of them are forged.
goals: See the law followed for once

npcs.name: Cole Bramwell
npcs.description: Big, polite and absolutely sure the claim is on his grazing land.
goals: Keep his ranch whole for his daughters

relationships.label: Ally
relationships.status: Thinks you might be the honest one

relationships.label: Rival
relationships.status: Wants your claim, not your blood

items.name: Torn map
items.description: Your uncle’s map of the claim, one corner missing.

items.name: Mule
items.description: Called Parson. Stubborn, sure-footed, and fond of apples.
